question: Should OpenClaw publish a public OpenAPI/Swagger contract for Gateway programmatic access, and should that contract be static, served at runtime, or replaced by a documented TypeBox/JSON Schema generation path?
rationale: This would define a supported external Gateway API surface, including auth, endpoint visibility, versioning, and upgrade compatibility, so automation should not choose the contract shape without maintainer intent.

options.title: Design Public Schema Contract First
options.body: Keep the issue open while maintainers choose schema format, exposure path, versioning model, and security boundary before implementation.

options.title: Publish Static Artifact Only
options.body: Provide a release-attached or committed schema artifact for client generation without adding a runtime schema endpoint yet.

options.title: Defer To Protocol Docs
options.body: Close later only if maintainers decide the TypeBox/JSON Schema pipeline and Gateway protocol docs are the intended client-generation surface.

recommendation.title: Design Public Schema Contract First
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open while maintainers choose schema format, exposure path, versioning model, and security boundary before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest adjacent OpenAPI/schema publication history through the closed generated config OpenAPI PR.
